> Staff engineer with 15+ years who owns product surfaces end to end and builds the platforms other teams depend on: frontend architecture, design systems, data access and release tooling. At Personio and DAZN I built design-system components and integration patterns that 4+ teams adopted, migrated five applications off a legacy monolith, moved a product domain's data access from legacy REST to the company GraphQL layer (5+ entities, 20+ endpoints retired), and cut p75 LCP 21% in production. Before that I designed a backend-for-frontend service and a logging library that became platform standards, and led full-stack teams for five years.

## Experience

### Staff Frontend Engineer · Personio
*Oct 2025 — Present · Amsterdam, NL*
HR platform for SMEs.

- Migrated my domain's data access off legacy REST onto the company-wide GraphQL layer: 5+ entities, 20+ endpoints retired, done incrementally alongside feature work with no dedicated project. Ended the dual data-access pattern that was driving architectural drift.
- Cut p75 LCP 21% in real-user monitoring across high-traffic surfaces by eliminating unused JavaScript and redrawing bundle boundaries.
- Defined and own the frontend integration model for company-wide groups management; shipped the first production use case to all customers; the pattern is now reused across 4+ product domains.
- Driving the connection of design-system components directly to product-domain data sources, so teams reuse one integration instead of re-wiring it: less duplication, stale API usage and UX drift.

### Lead Frontend Engineer · Personio
*Nov 2023 — Oct 2025 · Amsterdam, NL*
HR platform for SMEs.

- Led migration of 5+ applications off the legacy frontend monolith onto the modular stack, moving the domain from a slow, debt-accumulating codebase to one where features ship reliably.
- Owned frontend delivery of the central UI rebrand for my domain: 12+ stakeholders coordinated, a full-domain release with parallel UI to guarantee parity at launch.
- Designed reusable geolocation and mapping infrastructure (location services and UI components) used by multiple product teams without duplicating third-party integrations.
- Established the recurring frontend architecture forum for cross-team alignment and less implementation drift.

### Staff Frontend Engineer · DAZN
*Apr 2022 — Oct 2023 · Amsterdam, NL*
Global sports streaming.

- Designed and built governance tooling for the headless CMS architecture, letting multiple teams create and manage content models with consistent validation and version control.
- Drove the landing-pages micro-frontend toward Server-Driven UI on Next.js, decoupling layout control from frontend release cycles.
- Drove Design System adoption across 3+ frontend teams through guidance and code review: brand consistency, accessibility compliance, less per-team UI time.
- Optimized CI for a large monorepo, making build feedback more reliable, and standardized automated release workflows for cross-team libraries, cutting manual publishing errors and version drift.

### Senior Frontend Engineer · DAZN
*May 2021 — Mar 2022 · Amsterdam, NL*
Global sports streaming.

- Led core design-system components and design tokens, establishing atomic component patterns adopted across web applications; standardized token naming.
- Built shared internationalization utilities (dates, times, currencies) used across product surfaces.
- Presented architecture proposals to the frontend guild and technical council.

### Frontend Tech Lead · Travix
*Jun 2019 — Apr 2021 · Amsterdam, NL*
Online travel agency.

- Aligned frontend architecture across 4+ product teams, consolidating common patterns into shared libraries and cutting duplicated implementation.
- Technically led a product team through development cycles; mentored engineers inside and outside the company.
- Performance guild member, shaping the organisation's frontend strategy.

### Senior Frontend Engineer · Travix
*Mar 2019 — Jun 2019 · Amsterdam, NL*
Online travel agency.

- Designed the Node.js backend-for-frontend service that became the standard adopted across the platform.
- Created the shared server- and client-side logging library that aligned logging standards company-wide.

### Frontend Engineer · Travix
*Mar 2018 — Mar 2019 · Amsterdam, NL*
Online travel agency.

- Set up frontend observability metrics and maintained the observability services written in Go; product team on cross-sell products.

### Full Stack Team Lead · First Factory

Nearshore software development.
